trajectory_summary: The call moves efficiently and calmly through verify, and the rep secures a specific day/time with minimal friction — the address lookup hiccup and the wife's involvement are handled without derailing rapport. But the appointment lands soft: the bill was volunteered rather than flipped into leverage, the wife's presence at the call is never explicitly locked despite Dominic raising it himself, and the confirmation is contingent on the customer sending a bill later that evening.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown; based on the transcript this should be read as tentative, not booked. The rep says at 06:23 'once I get that bill from you, I'll just shoot you a confirmation text with the date and time of the meeting' — the appointment time is stated but the rep's own language makes confirmation contingent on a bill that hadn't arrived by end of call.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: closing the loop on the bill before treating the sit as locked
primary_coaching_focus.quote: once I get that bill from you, I'll just shoot you a confirmation text with the date and time of the meeting.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The appointment's own confirmation is explicitly gated on a bill Dominic won't send until evening — this is the single biggest risk to whether this becomes a real sit, and the rep should have a tighter plan (e.g., a specific time check-in) rather than an open-ended 'later this evening.'

Rep responds with 'Oh, gotcha. Okay. Gotcha.' and moves to the next verify question without reflecting the number back or tying it to the appointment's purpose.
